about: Cab test checklist (HANDOFF.md): per train the checks the cab test decides; marks c<n>: ok | issue; ids never reused.

checks.text: Check the throttle on the left: Off nearest, Ready band, effort zone, Max far.
Check the seven automatic brake bands on the right (Emergency far, Release nearest).
Check the cruise lever on the flap: Off nearest, Slow, mph zone.
Press PARK BRK: reverser handle lever plus cab activate button; the desk should wake.
ACSES, ATC and Alerter load cut out: check the aux toggles cut them in; round aux = parking brake.
Check the combined handle on the left lever: T Max far, Idle at the centre, B Max nearest.
Check the automatic brake bands on the right; Suppression has no band of its own.
Check ENG 2 raises and lowers the pantograph.
Press PARK BRK: the reverser handle goes in and the reverser moves (Out stays in the cab).
Confirm the slate US manual scheme (shared by the whole US / Canadian section).
ENG 1 (bell) and ENG 2 (pantograph): check whether the push buttons latch or need holding.
PARK BRK flat (Key Out): check it does not fight the speedbrake reverser lever.
Left throttle: confirm it moves only with the reverser in Forward and each of the nine steps gives the labelled notch.
Decide: dynamic brake on the flap versus the independent brake as a Full / Release toggle on the round aux.
Check the dynamic brake on the flap moves only with the reverser out of Neutral.
Check the nine throttle bands on the left and the seven automatic brake bands on the right.
Check the bail-off on ENG 2 holds while switched.
Check the wipers on the mode switch (WiperSpeed values 0 / 0.5 guessed).
Lead loco loads with a trailing-unit brake set-up: check whether MU-2A and brake cut-out must be set to Lead in the cab before brakes work.
Check the 13-step combined handle on the left: power notches are only 0.06 apart on the TCA.
Check the dynamic side of the handle moves only with the reverser out of Neutral.
Press PARK BRK: engine control switch should go to Run (no key on this loco).
Check the independent brake on the flap and the bail-off on ENG 2.
Check the bail-off on ENG 2: it is a spring and one set may not beat it.
Press PARK BRK: the push-button reverser handle goes In; throttle and reverser move only then.
Decide: dynamic brake on the flap versus the independent as a toggle on the round aux.
Check the dynamic brake on the flap moves only out of Neutral.
Check the nine throttle bands and seven automatic brake bands.
Confirm throttle (Off far) and vacuum brake (Emergency far) directions.
Right throttle vacuum zone: Initial to Full is continuous; check it.
Lights dial push buttons toggle on change: check they stay in step.
Decide which desk you drive from (one node set for both).
As the 08: confirm throttle and vacuum brake directions and the service zone.
Flap loco brake: one gate down from Full; check release works.
Lights dial push buttons: check toggling.
Throttle (left) and vacuum brake (right) directions were guessed from the 153: confirm Idle far and brake Apply far.
Right throttle vacuum brake: check Lap band and the release / apply zones either side.
PARK BRK: check the push-button MainSwitch latches through the mod.
Flap gear selector (Neutral far, 1st nearest): change gear only with the throttle closed.

tsw-class-142-dtg-thejag.name: BR Class 142
tsw-class-142-dtg-thejag.doneNote: All four checks ✓ (2026-10-16): horn, engine stop/start, AWS isolation, and the TfW / Skipper / Voith variants work equally well. README DONE ✅.
tsw-class-142-dtg-thejag.note: Just a comment; TfW, Skipper,  and Voith all work equally well. Mark as done.

checks.text: Aux squares: TPWS isolation (lit = 1) and DSD (lit = 0); both loaded Isolated, check the lamps mean isolated.
Right throttle only moves with the reverser in Forward; check power after selecting Forward.
Lights dial on the 9-position rotary: check Off / Day / Marker / Night / Tail land on the right positions.
Aux squares AWS isolation lever and vigilance isolation button (both lit = 1, loaded Isolated): check lamp means isolated.
Lights dial on the 9-position rotary (odd order of values): check each position.
EMT 158 on the MML was not captured; check it if you drive it.
Left throttle uses the 171 bands but the 165 stores 0.14 k: check P1-P7 for snap-back beeps.
Reverser lever: confirm direction (Off far, inverted).
Gear lever = AWS reset (held); ENG switches horn high / low.
DRA stays in the cab.
Same as the 165: check P1-P7 for beeps with the 171 bands and the reverser direction.
Left throttle combined handle: power side probed by hand; check B3 far, P7 nearest and no beeps on P1-P7 (171 bands reused).
PARK BRK master key is a push button; check it latches.
Aux squares AWS / DVD isolation (Isolated = 1, all loaded Isolated): check lamp meaning.
Lights dial Tail position uses the separate TailLights lever; check it.
Right throttle power: one gate down (Slow speed, On, Off); check closing the throttle fully reaches Off.
Reverser only moves with power at Off; confirm Forward far.
Confirm vacuum brake direction (Emergency far) and the service zone.
Lights dial marker push buttons: check toggling.
F desk wired only; drive from the F end.
Reverser only moves with the handle in Emergency: push the left throttle fully away (Emergency kept at raw 0) and decide if Emergency stays.
Left throttle zones: Max brake, brake zone, Min brake, Off at centre, Power 1, power zone; check each is reachable.
Four isolation levers loaded Isolated; check aux squares (AWS, vigilance) lit = isolated.
Round aux = CabSignalBuzzer (GuardSignal); check it sounds.
README is DONE, but drive once with the new profile.
Aux squares (AWS-TPWS, DSD isolation): confirm lit = isolated; the polarity (lit = value 0) was never confirmed by API.
README is DONE, but drive once with the new profile.
Aux squares (AWS-TPWS, DSD isolation): confirm lit = isolated; the polarity was never confirmed.
Right throttle (power) only moves with the reverser in Forward: confirm that is all.

tsw-class-323-dtg-thejag.name: BR Class 323
tsw-class-323-dtg-thejag.doneNote: Cab test 2 all ✓ (2026-10-17): power pulled towards the driver, DRA on the right throttle button. README DONE ✅.
tsw-class-323-dtg-thejag.note: Yes, power is towards the driver. Can we make the right throttle button the DRA? Delete the old profile.

checks.text: Right throttle train brake inverted: confirm direction and the service zone.
PARK BRK master key is a toggle button: check it latches through the mod.
Brake valve loads at Neutral-Shutdown: may need a second move to reach Running.
Decide which end you drive from (A / B marker lights); F desk wired only.
Left throttle inverted: max brake nearest, full power far; confirm against the desk T-handle.
Continuous handle: check Coast holds at the centre detent and brake/power zones feel right.
Power side only moves with the reverser in Forward.
Lights dial starts on Tail; check each position.
README is DONE, but drive once with the regenerated profile (sync blocks removed, sander now a direct control on the throttle button).

tsw-class-350-dtg-thejag.name: BR Class 350
tsw-class-350-dtg-thejag.doneNote: Cab test 2 all ✓ (2026-10-17): handle bands, DRA, tail light. README DONE ✅. Change of 2026-10-18 after the no-move drive: the first power step now sends 0.60 (about 11 % power, probed live) instead of the game's 1 % detent, so P1 on the TCA pulls away on its own. Say so here if it does not.
tsw-class-350-dtg-thejag.note: After the changes this one is now done

checks.text: Both handle directions: train brake left (Running far), power right (Off far); confirm.
Right throttle: check the power controller On band lands.
PARK BRK = MasterKey_F + CabChangeLever_F; check both keys go in and the handles unlock.
Reverser has uneven steps (Off band small); if it feels flaky, report so it gets respaced like the Class 31.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested).
Desk photo is dark; retake it with the cab light on.
README is DONE, but drive once with the new profile: P1-P4 were probed by hand, check each power notch on the left throttle.
README is DONE, but drive once with the new profile.
Round aux guard buzzer: SignalBell node has no identifier, confirm it sounds.
Lights dial uses the renamed `Taillights` node; check the tail position works.
PARK BRK master key: the key was left on during capture, so check it inserts and removes from a cold cab.
Left throttle (plain): power towards the driver assumed as the 350; confirm.
Power zone is fully continuous; say whether you want a first-power notch.
Aux squares: TPWS/AWS and Vigilance isolation start Isolated in service; check lit = Isolated (0) and un-isolating works.
Round aux = guard bell; check it.
Left throttle (plain): power towards the driver assumed as the 805; confirm, and check T-1 to T-4 land.
Aux squares AWSIS / DSDID: labels may be inverted (they read Cut-Out on a working train); check lit = Cut-Out polarity.
Check whether the hidden TrainBrake node needs the right throttle (does the handle brake alone stop the train?).
Round aux = DRA toggle; check it.
Reverser scale differs from the 377 (0 / 0.333 / 0.667 / 1); check every reverser position lands.
Lights dial uses the renamed `Taillights` node; check the tail position works.
Footer links the generic Brighton Main Line store page (no TSW 7 page found); confirm acceptable.
Left throttle reuses the 171 bands, so Off sits at raw 0.63, not the centre; check every notch B6-P4 without beeps.
Aux squares: Isolate = 0 → lit = 0; check lamp meaning (all loaded Isolate).
Lights dial uses the 'Exterior Lights' node (with a space); check it responds.
Left throttle inverted: max brake nearest, P4 far; confirm against the pedestal.
Check P1-P4 bands (uneven widths) and Min brake / Off.
Round aux guard buzzer node 'Signal' has no identifier; check it sounds.
Aux squares AWS-TPWS / DSD isolation (Isolated = 0 → lit = 0): check lamp meaning.
As the 47: confirm both handle directions (brake left, power right, Running / Off far).
Right throttle On band on the 0.31 detent: check it engages.
PARK BRK sets master key + cab change lever; engine must be started (right throttle button) before power works.
Lights dial marker / tail push buttons: check toggling.
F cab wired by name only.
Left throttle power: Idle at the far end, Max nearest you; right throttle brake: Emergency far, Running nearest.
Reverser lever: Engine off / Reverse / Neutral / Forward, Forward at the far end.
PARK BRK turns the master key; left/right throttle buttons stop and start the engine.
Aux squares AWS / DSD isolation: lit = isolated (AWS node has no identifier).
Only the EMT power car was captured: if you drive an FGW or GWR HST, check the levers still respond.
As the 47: confirm both handle directions and the On band.
PARK BRK sets master key + cab change toggle buttons: check they latch.
ENGINE STOPPED lamp stays lit although the engine runs; ignore unless power fails.
F cab wired by name only.
Left throttle plain with Emergency kept at the far end (as the 333); confirm B3 is not overshot into Emergency.
Mode switch wipers: uneven bands (Off / Int / Slow / Fast); check each step.
Lights dial: check Off / Day / Marker / Night / Tail positions.
Both handle directions: brake left (Running far), power right (Off far); confirm, and check the On band.
PARK BRK = MasterKey_F + CabChangeLever_F; check both keys go in and the handles unlock.
Cold start: only the battery was closed; check engine start on the right throttle button and whether more is needed.
Reverser will not leave Forward with the throttle at On; uneven steps; if flaky, report to respace like the 31.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested).
Right throttle brake inverted (Emergency far): confirm direction and the continuous EP zone.
Lights dial sends ON / OFF push-button presses: check lights toggle correctly through the mod.
Gear lever = key Q: check whether it acknowledges anything on this unit.
PARK BRK sets ReverserKey and MasterKeyLever: check both.
Check whether the desk 'Safety System Isolated' lamp needs the isolation levers at Cut-In first (aux squares, 1 = isolated).
Handle with the wide brake zone (B1 on the idle detent, Off on the soft stop, brake over raw 0..0.44): brake range long enough now? P1-P3 sit 0.07 apart: easy to hit, no beeps?

Headlight dial (Off / Day / Markers / Night / Tail), wipers on the mode switch and the AWS / DSD aux squares act now (full node names). The train loads isolated, so the first press of an aux square changes nothing and the second cuts the system in.
Horn on the right throttle button and whistle on the round aux (game keys Space / N): each sounds while held and stops on release. The ENG switches are unassigned.
As the 47: confirm both handle directions and the On band.
Right throttle button starts engine A, round aux starts engine B: check both start.
Right aux DSD fuse (1 = in): value unverified, check the lamp meaning.
Reverser: Forward far, Engine only nearest (second Engine only left out).
F cab wired only.
Cab-side placeholder {SIDE:F:B} is untested here (IS_GetActiveCab fails): if nothing moves, report it so the F-wired profile is restored.
Left throttle train brake and flap loco brake are rate levers (Release / Hold / Apply, Apply far): check holding at Apply builds pressure.
Right throttle: Stop far, notch 8 nearest; check all nine notches.
In the B cab the lights dial is off by one (Day and Night swapped); DSD isolation square only works in the F cab.
PARK BRK = reverser handle in; flip it down and up after a cab change. Parking brake is now in the cab.

tsw-class-70-aabs-thejag.name: BR Class 70
tsw-class-70-aabs-thejag.doneNote: Cab test all ✓ (2026-10-18): lever directions, reverser after PARK BRK, throttle on the notch without wobble, brake pipe charging at Release, Cab Enable pair, horn polarity, TMS loads Lead / Cut In, brake mode toggle on the round aux, PCS recovery. README DONE ✅.

checks.text: Power moves in Neutral (no Forward interlock); check the train does not creep with the reverser in Neutral and the handle in power.
Left throttle (plain, POWER nearest): check Power min, continuous zone, Brake low and Full service land.
Right throttle button = PowerSupply pulse; check it does what you expect.
AWS/TPWS and DSD isolation toggles read Isolated (0) at load; check lit = Isolated and that un-isolating works.
README is DONE, but drive once with the regenerated profile: horn on ENG switches and wipers on the mode switch were keys before.
Left throttle power side was probed by hand: check power zone and output notches 1-4 respond.
Check max brake far, Off at the centre, full power nearest.
Horn rest is 0.5 (capture default 0 was misleading); check the horn does not sound at rest.
Mode switch wipers have six speeds at 0.2 steps; check.
Left throttle (plain, power towards the driver): check Power 1 notch then continuous power to MAX, and the brake side Min to Max brake.
Isolation toggles: check lit = 0 is the isolated state, as on the 801.
Manual uses a GWR-livery 802 drawing (no GBR one exists); confirm that is acceptable.
Left throttle (plain, power towards the driver): check P1-P4 land on their own notches (P2 on the CL detent, P3 on FLX).
Brake side: check Min brake, continuous zone and Max brake; Emergency is left out.
Isolation toggles read 1 = Isolated on a working train; check lit = 0 really is the isolated state.
Left throttle: P3 / P4 were assumed at k/4 (sampled while moving); check both notches land and hold.
Speed limiter is not on the TCA; decide whether you want it on the flap lever (needs a probe first).
Isolation toggles: check lit = 0 is the isolated state, as on the 805.
Rotary brake and reverser directions were guessed from a photo: confirm brake Running far / Emergency near and reverser Forward far.
Reverse only engages while the cab's reverser lock button is held; check you can get Reverse at all.
Right throttle tap changer: Off nearest, Notch up far (Run up never appeared); check notching up and down works.
Left throttle service zone: check the brake applies smoothly between 1st application and Full service.
Cab-side placeholder {SIDE:F:B} untested (IS_GetActiveCab fails): if nothing responds, report it.
PARK BRK sets master key and brake key together; check both turn.
Same as the 86: confirm the rotary brake (Running far) and reverser (Forward far) directions.
Reverse only with the cab's lock button held; check you can reach it.
Right throttle tap changer Off nearest / Notch up far: check notching up and down.
Lights dial: both marker lights (FL and FR) should switch together.
Cab-side placeholder {SIDE:F:B} untested: if nothing responds, report it.
Right throttle button raises the pan and pulses the circuit breaker: press again once the pan is up and check the breaker closes.
Straight air brake is not on the TCA (springs back): confirm you can live with it in the cab.
Right throttle power: Off and Min bands, then continuous to Max; check the Min notch and the zone.
Aux squares: AWS isolation (Isolated = 1) and DSD (Isolated = 0) have opposite polarity; check both lamps mean isolated.
Cab-side placeholder {SIDE:F:B} untested (IS_GetActiveCab false/false): if nothing responds, report it.
Gear lever press: check it frees the reverser and power handle through the mod (press, reverser, press, power).
Left throttle: check the 18 bands land on each notch and pass the Idle→P1, Idle→Setup and Setup→B1 gates.
PARK BRK up: confirm the seven cold switches come on and the train takes power and brakes.
Press PARK BRK on the part-cold desk: reverser handle, cut-off valve, engine run, generator field, control & fuel pump.
Check the six automatic brake detents on the right (Emergency far, Release nearest).
Check the spring bail-off on ENG 2; it may need the cab.
Check the dynamic brake on the flap (out of Neutral only) and the independent toggle on the round aux.
Northbound services start on the uncaptured Gallery cab car; pick a southbound service.
PARK BRK up: confirm the five-part desk set-up (handle, brake cut-in, engine run, field, fuel pump) gives traction and brakes.
Round aux: confirm the parking brake as the stand-in independent works for you.
ENG 2: confirm the bail switch releases the brakes.
Flap: confirm the dynamic brake works (free in Neutral, unlike the F40PH).
Press PARK BRK: reverser handle, generator field and brake cut-out; the loco should load and brake.
MU-2A loads mid-zone: check whether it must be set to Lead by hand.
Check the spring bail-off on ENG 2.
Check the independent on the flap and the 26L bands on the right.
Press PARK BRK on the part-cold desk: reverser handle, cut-off valve, engine run, generator field, control & fuel pump.
MU2A valve loads Trail and is not on PARK BRK: check the brakes work or set Lead in the cab.
Check the 13-step combined handle on the left (power notches close together; dynamic not locked in Neutral here).
Check the automatic brake bands on the right and the spring bail-off on ENG 2.
Decide the cdblue colour scheme (ČD sky blue accent; flag red is the alternative) for both Czech manuals.
Left throttle: confirm the handwheel direction (notch 8 at the far end, Neutral nearest) feels right.
Right throttle: confirm the BS2 direction (Quick Release far, Cutout and Emergency nearest) and the apply zone.
Left aux: confirm VZ Active is the right train-protection mode (Off when down).
ENG 1: with the reverser in Engine Only, hold up about 8 s and confirm the engine starts.
PARK BRK up: confirm handle in plus BS2 key unlocked frees the reverser and brake; ENG 2 releases the brake (OL2).
Right throttle: check tapping the spring positions S (power up), BE (dynamic) and BP (air) builds power and brake usably; else ask for held momentaries.
Right throttle: confirm the direction (S far, R emergency nearest) and that J holds and V coasts.
RUD TRIM: confirm door unlock left / right toggle on and lock again on a second press.
ENG 1: check the engine start sequence (unverified; engines load running in the service).
PARK BRK up: confirm master key Master plus brakes cut in; left aux LS90 On; round aux ARR Automatic.
Decide the cdblue colour scheme together with the 750.
Check the transition lever on the flap: throttle is locked in Off; leaving Braking is refused with the throttle open.
Check the 24RL five bands on the right: Emergency far, Running nearest (Release unreachable).
Check the four light push buttons on the lights dial take plain sets.
Check the safety pedal held on the gear lever.
Press PARK BRK: engine run, generator field, fuel pump & control (no key).
Hold the mode switch about half a second: the ratchet selector should move exactly one step (left toward B, right toward 4).
The throttle only moves with the reverser handle in and the selector on 1..4.
Check the dynamic handle on the flap in B; return it to Off before leaving B (B to OFF was refused).
Press PARK BRK: five pairs including cut-off pilot valve Freight; the automatic brake is dead until Freight.
Check the spring bail-off on ENG 2; the lights dial has no Off (Dim).
Press PARK BRK (five pairs); if the reverser stays locked, cycle PARK BRK a second time (first ReverserHandle set can fail).
Check the spring bail-off on ENG 2.
Check the 26L bands on the right (Handle Off 0.85 here) and the independent on the flap.
Check the ditch-light toggle on the round aux (Front / Off).
Press PARK BRK: reverser handle, generator field and brake cut-out to Freight.
Check the spring bail-off on ENG 2.
Check the independent on the flap and the 26L bands on the right (Handle Off 0.9).
Check both fuse toggles on the left aux (alerter and safety devices load off).
Press PARK BRK: brake cut-out and MU-2A to Lead plus generator field; the brakes should then respond.
Check the 13-step combined handle on the left; power notches are close together.
Check the dynamic side moves only with the reverser out of Neutral.
Bail-off on ENG 2 holds at 1 (no spring): check it releases when switched back.
Confirm the 1986 CSX mark (wordmark available instead).
Press PARK BRK: brake cut-out to Freight (loads Cut Out), MU-2A Lead, generator field; the brakes should then respond.
Check the 13-step combined handle on the left; power notches are close together.
Check the dynamic side moves only with the reverser out of Neutral.
Bail-off on ENG 2 holds at 1 (no spring): check it releases when switched back.
MU-2A loads Trail and is not on PARK BRK: check the brakes work or set Lead in the cab.
Press PARK BRK: reverser handle, generator field, brake cut-out Freight.
Check the bail-off on ENG 2 against the independent's spring zone (one set springs back).
Decide: dynamic brake on the flap versus independent as a toggle on the round aux.
Check whether the MU-2A valve must be set to Lead in the cab (not on PARK BRK).
Press PARK BRK: reverser handle, generator field, cut-off pilot valve Freight.
Check the bail-off on ENG 2 against the spring.
Decide: dynamic brake on the flap versus independent toggle on the round aux.
Left throttle Fahrschalter: confirm direction (Z far, 0 nearest) and whether the Min notch is any use.
Right throttle brake: check the 171 bands land on the cab-car brake notch values.
Aux squares proxy switches: check they really switch SiFa / PZB from the cab (else SifaSwitch / PZB_Isolation).
Decide whether the DynamicBrake should go on the free flap lever.
PARK BRK holds the reverser key while up: check the reverser moves (otherwise it never will).
Reverser only moves with the Fahrschalter at Off.
Dynamic brake stays in the cab; confirm acceptable.
Cab-side placeholder on 14 nodes: check after a cab change (flip PARK BRK).
Emergency brake valves may read Applied after the capture: reload the service if the train will not release.

tsw-br-103-dtg-thejag.name: DB BR 103
tsw-br-103-dtg-thejag.doneNote: Cab test 2 all ✓ (2026-10-17): taps 0–3 easy to select, Release holds and overcharges, the Zusatzbremse Apply zone holds, no lever wobble. README DONE ✅.

checks.text: Flap: check the Zusatzbremse apply zone works (the sweep did not register it).
Speedbrake lever: confirm the four positions read Reverse / Off / Neutral / Forward (the sweep mislabelled Off and Neutral).
Left throttle: confirm the 29-tap handwheel steps cleanly.
Right throttle: confirm the nine brake notches sit on the TCA detents.
Left throttle: check the Auf / Ab Fahrschalter (Off nearest, Ab, Halt, Auf, Power far) builds and drops power usably.
Right throttle: confirm the brake notches sit on the TCA detents.
Lights dial: positions 2 and 3 are empty; confirm Off / Headlights / Tail suffice.
Mode switch: confirm the wiper steps (relative 0.25) work.
Left throttle: confirm the continuous Zugkraftsteller (force) feels right, more force pushed away.
Flap: check the AFB speed bands (160 far, On 0.93, Off nearest) select speed usably.
Zusatzbremse is not assigned: check whether you need it.
Left aux / right aux: confirm SiFa and PZB switches toggle on (On = 0.5).
Right throttle: confirm the ten brake notches sit on the TCA detents.
Push the left throttle away: the Zugkraftsteller force should rise (inverted, as the BR 112); confirm the direction feels right.
Flap lever: far = 160 km/h, nearest = AFB Off, just before it AFB On; check the speed zone tracks smoothly.
Aux toggles: Sifa_Switch / PZB_Switch use 0 / 1 here (0.5 on the 112); confirm both switch on and off.
Lights dial: Off / White / White low (middle lamp off) / Red; check each position sets the right lamps.
Mode switch: wipers are two-state on this loco; check it turns them on and off.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK down and up and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested; if nothing moves at all, report).
Flap lever (Zusatzbremse): the sweep never registered the Apply side; check pulling it actually applies the loco brake.
Richtungsschalter on the left throttle: check Reverse / Off / Neutral / Forward land correctly (the F cab labels were scrambled).
Left throttle handwheel: check the 29 taps step up when pushed away and down when pulled, without skipping.
Doors y / u on RUD TRIM do nothing on a freight loco; confirm that is harmless.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK down and up and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested).
Left throttle: Zugkraftsteller direction (push away = more force) as the 112; confirm.
Flap lever AFB (120 far, On, Off nearest) was swept only at 10 km/h; check the bands and range.
Mode switch wiper step 0.5 (On / Off / On); check it.
PARK BRK = ReverserHandle_F + BrakeKey_F; check reverser and brake valve unlock.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested).
Rapid Transit Talent 2 (class RVM_DB_Talent2_T2_C): the BR 1442 profile auto-selects and handle, reverser and master switch respond (nodes carry a type suffix; the BR 442 profile cannot drive it).
Sand: the left throttle button sets the sander to Front bogie (1) while held, Off (0.5) at rest; report if the wrong bogie sands.
SiFa / PZB isolation aux squares write a direct 0 / 1 to toggle push buttons; confirm the lit state matches the cab.
Gear lever = SiFa reset through the SifaPedalReset button (not key Q): confirm it clears the SiFa warning.
Wipers: MODE switch moves one notch per press over six positions (0..5).
The rest as the DB BR 442 checks: handle direction, a set straight after a gate, train brake valve left in the cab, Tempomat unmapped. One shared manual for 442 / 1442.
PARK BRK holds the reverser key: check the reverser moves through the mod.
Check whether the desk needs activating in the cab first ('Kein Führerstand besetzt').
Fahrschalter only moves with the reverser in Forward.
F cab wired by name only (no cab-side placeholder); drive from the F cab.
Richtungsschalter: if it stays locked, the unused ReverserHandle_F key is the cause; report it so it goes on PARK BRK the 101 way.
Secondary switches were never swept (assumed 185 values): check lights dial, wipers, Sifa/PZB fuses, PZB levers, sander and horn.
PARK BRK = AFB_F on / off; check it.
Flap lever AFB: check the full range and for 5 km/h snap clicking as on the 101.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested).
PARK BRK = Activate/DeactivateDriversCompartment push buttons + brake cut-out; check the desk activates and the power side unlocks; else keep one button.
Left throttle (inverted): check the Off band width at the centre and that power away / brake nearest feels right.
Richtungsschalter: Forward far assumed as the 185; confirm direction.
Aux squares: SIFA / PZB back-wall switches stay on the F cab; check they work and un-isolate.
Doors y / u on RUD TRIM: check they open the doors as on the 146.
After a cab change flip PARK BRK and check the TCA drives the B cab (active-cab placeholder untested).
Left throttle tap changer (30 far): check direction and whether it walks one step per send or jumps to the position.
Right throttle: twelve tight brake bands; check each lands, especially 50 % / 75 % on the detents.
